name: Three-cell player falls into the void as one rigid body
description:
The player moves north, descends for three ticks, then disappears as a whole body on tick five. No gem is present; this copied scene tests rigid-body falling and void removal, not gem collection.

One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 5 ticks after Start.
Player: 3 cells, starting at (0, 4, 1) through (1, 4, 2). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone.

Tick 1: Player moves 1 north.
Ticks 2–4 (each tick): Player moves 1 down.
Tick 5: Player disappears.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
